- Sudden, complete whole-plant wilting while plants remain green
- Isolated to specific plants while neighbors appear healthy
- Black plastic mulch bed with wooden stakes

**Comparison results:**
- **Southern_Bacterial_Wilt**: The reference image (code 5593857 - consecutive to the test image's 5593858) shows an **identical scene** - same black plastic mulch beds, wooden stakes, sandy dry soil, same localized sudden plant collapse. Strongest visual match.
- **Bacterial_Wilt**: Also shows whole-plant collapse on black plastic mulch with similar wilting pattern. Good match but reference plants appear more yellowed/dried.

The consecutive image numbering (5593857 in SBW reference vs 5593858 in test) and virtually identical field conditions strongly support Southern_Bacterial_Wilt.
